sql:
SELECT tss_rank, tss_team, tss_points
FROM team_season_standings tss
JOIN seasons s ON s.season_id = tss.season_id
WHERE s.season = '2022-2023'
ORDER BY tss_rank ASC;

out.notes: Join team_season_standings to seasons on season_id, filter seasons.season='2022-2023'. Select tss_rank, tss_team, tss_points; order by tss_rank ASC. tss_points already includes any deductions. Grain: one row per team-season (20 rows).
